request.style: English, musical theatre ensemble number, a tenor as Joseph and a men's chorus as his brothers, sweeping orchestra with strings and horns, from tension to tearful reunion, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Make everyone go out from me
And no one stayed with him
He wept so loudly that Egypt heard
I am Joseph, is my father still alive

[Verse]
His brothers could not answer him
They were dismayed at his presence
Come near to me, please, he said
I am your brother whom you sold into Egypt

[Chorus]
Do not be distressed or angry with yourselves
God sent me before you to preserve life
You meant evil against me
But God meant it for good

[Verse]
So it was not you who sent me here, but God
He has made me a father to Pharaoh
Hurry and go up to my father
And tell him, come down to me, do not tarry

[Chorus]
Do not be distressed or angry with yourselves
God sent me before you to preserve life
You meant evil against me
But God meant it for good
